teaser.en: Coffee with ginger after an operation: on the coast this spicy root is trusted to help people back on their feet.
teaser.sw: Kahawa yenye tangawizi baada ya upasuaji: pwani, mzizi huu wenye ukali huaminiwa kumsaidia mtu kurudia hali yake.
teaser.dg: Kahawa na tangawizi bada ya kupasuliwa: pwani, muzi huno mkali nkuluphirwa kuterya atu apone.

summary.en: *Tangawizi* is ginger, a spicy root used in tea, coffee, cooking and medicine. Some is grown in gardens, but most is bought.
summary.sw: *Tangawizi* ni tangawizi, mzizi wenye ukali unaotumika katika chai, kahawa, mapishi na dawa. Kiasi fulani hupandwa bustanini, lakini sehemu kubwa hununuliwa.
summary.dg: *Tangawizi* (kpwa Chingereza *ginger*) ni muzi mkali unaohumirwa kpwenye chai, kahawa, vyakurya na dawa. Tangawizi yanjina nkurimwa busitani, ela nyinji nkugulwa.

about.en: Ginger is a leafy plant with tall, reed-like stems carrying narrow, pointed leaves in two rows. The part used is the rhizome, an underground stem that is knobbly and pale brown outside, with a fibrous, pale yellow, hot and fragrant flesh.
about.sw: Tangawizi ni mmea wenye majani mengi, wenye mashina marefu kama matete yanayobeba majani membamba yenye ncha kali katika safu mbili. Sehemu inayotumika ni kiazi chake, shina la chini ya ardhi lenye vifundo, la rangi ya kahawia hafifu kwa nje, na nyama yenye nyuzinyuzi, ya manjano hafifu, kali na yenye harufu nzuri.
about.dg: *Tangawizi* ni mmea wenye makodza manji, na mihi mirefu dza mridza yenye makodza membamba genye ntsa, ganayokala mistari miiri. Seemu inayohumirwa ni *rhizome*, muhi urio tsini ya ulongo; kondze una maugu na ni wa rangi ya dongo ngushu-ngushu, na nyamaze ni za nyuzi-nyuzi, za rangi ya mandano ngushu-ngushu, kali na zenye mzingo.

where.en: Ginger is grown in some gardens on the south coast, but most is bought.
where.sw: Tangawizi hupandwa katika baadhi ya bustani katika pwani ya kusini, lakini sehemu kubwa hununuliwa.
where.dg: Tangawizi inarimwa busitani zanjina za pwani ya kusini, ela nyinji nkugulwa.

uses.en: Ginger goes into tea, as *chai ya tangawizi*, and into the strong black coffee of the coast. It is used in cooking and in medicine.
uses.sw: Tangawizi hutiwa katika chai, kama *chai ya tangawizi*, na katika kahawa chungu nzito ya pwani. Hutumika katika mapishi na kama dawa.
uses.dg: Tangawizi nkutiywa chai, dza *chai ya tangawizi*, na kahawa nyiru na kali ya pwani. Inahumirwa kujitira vyakurya na kpwenye dawa.

culture.en: Ginger coffee is thought of as a restorative; in Digo, coffee with ginger is the drink recommended after an operation.
culture.sw: Kahawa ya tangawizi huchukuliwa kuwa kinywaji cha kurejesha nguvu; kwa Wadigo, kahawa yenye tangawizi ndicho kinywaji kinachopendekezwa baada ya upasuaji.
culture.dg: Kahawa ya tangawizi nkuonwa dza chinwadzi cha kuuyiza nguvu; kpwa Adigo, kahawa na tangawizi ni chinwadzi ambacho mutu nkuambirwa anwe bada ya kupasuliwa.

names.en: The Digo name is *tangawizi*, the same as in Swahili. In English it is ginger.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *tangawizi*, sawa na la Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza inaitwa *ginger*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *tangawizi*, sawa na Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *ginger*.

reason.sw: Kahawa, ambayo mara nyingi hutiwa tangawizi
reason.dg: Kahawa, ambayo mara nyinji nkutiywa tangawizi.

reason.sw: Wa familia moja; iliki, kiungo kingine cha chai
reason.dg: Mbari mwenga; iliki, chitu chanjina chinachotiywa chai.

reason.en: Another kitchen spice used in medicine
reason.sw: Kiungo kingine cha jikoni kinachotumika kama dawa
reason.dg: Chitu chanjina cha kujitira chinachohumirwa piya kpwenye dawa.
